result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot, Pipedrive or Zoho CRM**\. The best choice depends on whether you prioritise simplicity, sales management or keeping costs down.

If I had to pick one without knowing anything else, I'd start with **HubSpot** for a general small business, or **Pipedrive** for a team focused on winning new customers.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent free starting plan.
- Contact management, sales pipelines and email tracking.
- Marketing and customer service tools available as you grow.
- Easy for a small team to adopt.

Best for: Businesses wanting an all-round CRM.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very clear visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads, deals and follow-ups.
- Easy to see what everyone is working on.
- Good sales reporting.

Best for: Teams actively selling products or services.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Very competitive pricing.
- Strong automation and customisation.
- Integrates with other Zoho applications.
- Free option for up to three users.

Best for: Teams wanting lots of features on a budget.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales Reviews, Pricing, Key Info, and FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/K07S4lupkbqzQ7IJWsbLQDl_aw7G-Q5ck81gT3hTCuqSl43anPhnfDFmDbefUOdxVsjYLm_LYWgGTWI98sFAWedta2QsUixC7OM_PM1s6Y1EuFzTcZSsdi41c8KkyM-mHP8elkKTEPCnO2Il_HO6e_HYAMF4L3eSNfQjDBIzFOFumlny6cGeRX7F_U4CyLr6?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in email, phone and chat capabilities.
- Lead scoring and automation.
- Good value entry-level paid plans.

Best for: Teams managing lots of enquiries and customer conversations.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![The Best CRM Software for Designers, Artists & Real Estate Agents](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aGZxaud4q3cvW6D4kplicJbw3lj5aY7OkJMu751HNJvN-Z6fTsofY1fI2lv3t2JuSrlAUNpIZbK_EkYz81V6l6wGjzjCvur9YwAO1MVb4x2YNszRWgZ7Gssj0YyDH_afSDs3GAZUOL97SxBJEnHLtAcWL7f7jQA1UIE7oJOJDcp8j8QmSmrvpYYVDbcNlTWF?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Capsule CRM**

- Simple, uncluttered interface.
- Contact and relationship management.
- Sales pipeline and task management.
- Particularly suitable for smaller UK businesses.

Best for: Teams that don't want a complicated system.

[Capsule website](https://capsulecrm.com/)

## Quick comparison

| CRM | Best feature | Starting point |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round CRM | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales pipeline | \~£14/user/month |
| Zoho | Value and features | Free / \~£12/user/month |
| Freshsales | Sales communications | \~£7/user/month |
| Capsule | Simplicity | Free |


Prices are indicative UK entry-level figures and can change by billing frequency and plan.
